title: Places & directions
practiceFocus: Explain how to get from home to a place

points.title: Where something is
points.rule: Ser says who you are. Está says where a place is. Voy from day 4 plus en names the transport: voy en metro. Voy andando is on foot. Siga and gire are fixed direction phrases. Say them whole. Do not build an imperative chart.

grammar.notYet: The full estar table. Feelings come on day 11. Do not study the imperative.

phrases.note: A fixed direction phrase. Do not change the ending.
Another fixed direction phrase, like siga.

phrases.spanish: El parque está al lado del café.
phrases.english: The park is next to the café.
How do I get to the centre?
phrases.note: Learn the question as one chunk.
Vivo is still the day 6 chunk.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.english: Excuse me, where is the museum?

lines.speaker: Local
lines.spanish: Siga todo recto y gire a la izquierda.

lines.speaker: Local
lines.spanish: No, está cerca. Diez minutos andando.
lines.english: No, it is close. Ten minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: Local
lines.english: You’re welcome. Have a good day!

practice.title: From home to a place
practice.instruction: Explain how you get from home to the station, a café, or work. Use está for the place and voy for how you travel.
tips: Use está for location, not soy.
